extracted.intended_audience: readers interested in Civil War–era plantation life, freedmen labor experiments, and historical travel narratives
extracted.subtask_description: First-person travelogue and reportage describing free-labor experiments, leasing of plantations, planter and lessee behavior, and local conditions along the Mississippi during the U.S. Civil War. The text narrates observations, incidents, and social/political attitudes rather than giving prescriptive guidance.
